title: Enterprise Compliance Milestone Roadmap — onboarding & controls sequencing
creator: Leah Martinez
description:
Purpose: Provide a sequenced milestone plan for onboarding enterprise customers that require SOC2/ISO controls, SSO/SAML, and robust audit logging. This ticket consolidates deliverables across product, engineering, security, and legal and acts as the single source of truth for milestone tracking, acceptance criteria, and rollout gating.

Scope: MVP set of controls necessary for sales-led enterprise onboarding, including: 1) SOC2 Type II readiness checklist and evidence collection for core services (API, Console, Dedicated), 2) ISO27001 gap remediation items for TLS, encryption-at-rest, and change management, 3) SSO/SAML integration (IdP metadata, provisioning, SCIM optional), 4) Audit log ingestion/export/retention policy and UI for log retrieval & masking.

Out of scope: Full SOC2 audit execution (will be tracked as separate audit engagement ticket), long-term retention add-ons (>1 year) pricing plan, on-prem packaging beyond initial Private deployment checklist.
acceptance_criteria: SOC2 readiness checklist items implemented for API and Console, with evidence artifacts linked and owner assigned
SSO/SAML integration available in Console with IdP metadata upload, successful e2e test with Okta and ADFS
Audit logs export endpoint implemented and documented; retention configuration up to 365 days configurable in Console for Dedicated/Private customers
ISO27001 high-priority gaps (encryption-at-rest, KMS integration, change control) closed or assigned with remediation plan
Rollout plan defined with canary group (internal beta customers), success metrics (login success rate, log latency), and rollback criteria
milestones: M1 (2026-02-28): Inventory & Evidence — Product/Security to finalize control inventory and map owners. Deliverable: control matrix + evidence links. Owner: Security (Priya Rao)
M2 (2026-03-15): SSO/SAML Console v1 — Implement IdP metadata upload + SP endpoints, internal e2e tests with Okta. Owner: Platform (Arjun Patel)
M3 (2026-03-30): Audit Logs API + Retention — Add log export endpoint, retention toggle in Console (30/90/365 days). Owner: Observability (Marcos Li)
M4 (2026-04-07): ISO Remediation Sprint — Close high-risk gaps (KMS integration, disk encryption validation). Owner: Infrastructure (Sofia Nguyen)

M5 (2026-04-15): Canary Rollout & Readiness Review — Internal beta customers on Dedicated capacity, run smoke tests, SOC2 evidence pack prepared. Stakeholder readiness sign-off required. Owner: PM (Leah Martinez)
